inputs.name: ReportRepository.constructor.root
inputs.description: Optional storage root. The constructor has no parameter initializer, so omission passes undefined; reportFiles then uses a truthy PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME or falls back to join(homedir(), '.codex', 'project-reports').

inputs.name: ReportRepository.directory.id
inputs.description: Report run identifier used under the runs directory; safeId accepts 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

inputs.name: ReportRepository.begin.input
inputs.description: Defines the project, title, mode, and environment for a new report; project and title must be truthy, and mode must be feature or suite. Falsey environment, summary, and acceptance become local, an empty string, and an empty array; historical is boolean-coerced and revision is copied when supplied.

inputs.name: ReportRepository.get.id
inputs.description: Report run identifier whose manifest is loaded; safeId accepts 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

inputs.name: ReportRepository.record.id
inputs.description: Report run identifier to update; safeId accepts 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

inputs.name: ReportRepository.record.record
inputs.description: Discriminated record to validate and ingest; kind is check, evidence, finding, coverage, acceptance, summary, or heartbeat, and data must be a non-array object. Summary requires string text, acceptance allows at most 30 short nonempty strings, and item/evidence kinds have title, status, and path constraints.

inputs.name: ReportRepository.mutateActive.id
inputs.description: Report run identifier to update; safeId accepts 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

inputs.name: ReportRepository.mutateActive.update
inputs.description: Async callback invoked with the active Report and its directory while the report lock is held; it is awaited before evidence storage and manifest writing.

inputs.name: ReportRepository.seal.id
inputs.description: Report run identifier to finalize; safeId accepts 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

inputs.name: ReportRepository.finish.id
inputs.description: Report run identifier whose finalizing state is to be completed; safeId accepts 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

outputs.name: ReportRepository.directory
outputs.description: Returns the filesystem path join(root, 'runs', safeId(id)) for the requested report.

outputs.name: ReportRepository.begin
outputs.description: Resolves to the new Report created by reportState after its run directory and manifest are written.

outputs.name: ReportRepository.get
outputs.description: Resolves to the parsed manifest at runs/<id>/manifest.json; rejects when the report directory is a symlink or filesystem/JSON loading fails.

outputs.name: ReportRepository.list
outputs.description: Resolves to directory-backed reports sorted by startedAt descending; unreadable runs directories and individual manifests are skipped.

outputs.name: ReportRepository.record
outputs.description: Resolves to the updated active Report after record ingestion, evidence storage for evidence records, and manifest writing.

outputs.name: ReportRepository.mutateActive
outputs.description: Resolves to the active Report after the callback, evidence storage, and manifest writing complete.

outputs.name: ReportRepository.seal
outputs.description: Resolves to the Report in finalizing state with resultStatus applied; evidence unavailable during finalization is marked missing and not-proven.

outputs.name: ReportRepository.finish
outputs.description: Resolves to the Report in finalized state after updating updatedAt and writing the manifest.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Raised for invalid report IDs, invalid begin or record values, prohibited state transitions, and failures propagated from filesystem, locking, persistence, or storage operations.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Raised by JSON.parse when a stored manifest is not valid JSON; get and operations that load a report propagate it.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: list can reject while sorting if a parsed manifest has a startedAt value without a callable localeCompare method.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for an invalid safe ID or a symbolic-link report directory; filesystem lookup/read failures also reject.

errors.name: SyntaxError

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for an invalid safe ID, invalid record data, or a report state other than active; persistence and evidence storage failures also reject.

outputs.name: ReportRepository.mutateActive
outputs.description: Resolves to the active Report after the callback, evidence storage, and manifest writing complete.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for an invalid safe ID or a report state other than active; callback, evidence storage, and persistence rejections propagate.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Raised by JSON.parse when a stored manifest is not valid JSON; get and operations that load a report propagate it.

outputs.name: ReportRepository.seal

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for an invalid safe ID or an already-finalized report; filesystem and manifest-write failures reject. Asset verification failures are caught and mark evidence unavailable.

errors.name: SyntaxError
